name: Dean, SCIT - Dr. George Musumba
description: Dr. George Musumba is the Dean of the School of Computing & Information Technology (SCIT) at DeKUT. He leads academic vision, departmental research, computing curriculum development, student academic petitions, and faculty administration.

name: Chairman of Department (COD) - Computer Science
description: The Chairman of Department (COD) for Computer Science manages CS course allocations, CAT/Exam moderation, student academic counseling, and thesis/project supervisor assignments.

name: Chairman of Department (COD) - Information Technology
description: The Chairman of Department (COD) for Information Technology oversees IT degree curriculum, practical lab sessions, industry certifications, and student attachment placement.

name: BSc Computer Science
description: The Bachelor of Science in Computer Science is a 4-year undergraduate program focusing on algorithms, software development, AI, theoretical computing, operating systems, networks, and systems design.

name: BSc Software Engineering
description: A 4-year degree program emphasizing large-scale software system design, DevOps, cloud architecture, software testing, Agile methodologies, and enterprise application development.

name: BSc Information Technology
description: Focuses on IT infrastructure, database management, network administration, cybersecurity fundamentals, enterprise IT service management, and web technologies.

name: MSc Computer Science & Data Science
description: A 2-year postgraduate program offering advanced tracks in Machine Learning, Distributed Systems, Computer Vision, Big Data Analytics, and Cyber Security.

name: Ada Lovelace AI & High-Performance Computing Lab
description: State-of-the-art laboratory equipped with GPU clusters reserved for AI/ML research, deep learning coursework, software engineering, and student capstone projects.

name: Cisco Networking & Cyber Security Lab
description: Specialized lab equipped with Cisco routers, switches, firewall appliances, and ethical hacking simulation suites for CCNA and Cybersecurity practicals.

name: SCIT Final Year Capstone Project Guidelines
description: All 4th-year SCIT students must complete a two-semester capstone project. Proposal defence is in Semester 1 (Week 8), and final code submission + live demonstration takes place in Semester 2 (Week 12). Code must be pushed to the SCIT GitHub Organization.

name: Industrial Attachment & Internship Requirements
description: SCIT undergraduates are required to undertake a mandatory 12-week industrial attachment during the recess term following Year 3. Logbooks and supervisor evaluation forms must be submitted within 2 weeks of completion.

name: SCIT Past Examination Papers & Revision Guidance
description: SCIT past papers for Programming (C++, Java, Python), Data Structures & Algorithms, Operating Systems, Database Systems, Computer Networks, and Software Engineering are hosted in the SCIT Student Resource Drive and DeKUT Library Repository. Revision strategy: practice pseudo-code writing, database schema normalization, and network subnetting calculations.
location: SCIT Resource Portal & Turing Lab 1 Drive

name: SCIT Tech Club & GDSC (Google Developer Student Club)
description: Student-led organization hosting weekly coding bootcamps, hackathons, open-source workshops, and developer meetups for SCIT students.
